Recipe.Title: Mexican Rice of Comfort
Recipe.Source: A Mexican waitress friend named Consuelo
Recipe.Description:
At a Mexican restaurant that we love, we built up a relationship with one of the waitresses named Consuelo. At one point she came over to our house and made us a Mexican meal from scratch.
It was so AWESOME, that Ransom and Di had her come back over and make it again so he could write down what she did and create this recipe.
NOTE:
"Mexican Rice of Comfort" translated to Spanish is "Arroz Mexicano de Consuelo"
"Mexican Rice from Consuelo" translated to Spanish is "Arroz Mexicano de Consuelo"
Since they are both the same, and since this recipe is from Consuelo… &smiley;
(See Also Mexican Beans of Comfort)

section.prep: In a bowl, mix Water, Chicken Bouillon, and Tomato Paste.
Finely chop the Cilantro and add it to the bowl.
Slice Roma Tomato into ¼&inches; disks, then slice the disks into quarters. Then add it to the bowl and set the bowl aside.
Slice Onion into ¼&inches; disks, then cut the disks into ⅛ths. Separate the Onion pieces and set aside.

section.instruction: Put Olive Oil in a skillet and tip it around until bottom is covered.
Put skillet on a burner at medium-high and give it a minute to heat up.
Add Onions and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add Garlic (Minced) and sauté for another minute.
Add Rice and sauté for another minute.
Add all other ingredients and stir well, then cover with skillet's lid. DO NOT REMOVE LID OR STIR AGAIN UNTIL COOKING IS COMPLETED!!!
Turn burner to medium and simmer for 15-20 minutes. DO NOT REMOVE LID OR STIR AGAIN UNTIL COOKING IS COMPLETED!!!
Remove skillet from burner then scrape the bottom of the skillet to ensure no rice is stuck to it. Then stir gently to ensure Tomatoes, Onions, etc are evenly distrubuted

Notes.note: While cooking, DO NOT REMOVE LID OR STIR AGAIN UNTIL COOKING IS COMPLETED!!!

Modifications.modification: If doubling the recipe, it will generally take about 10 minutes longer to simmer.
